baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine dual form مُدْهَامَّتَانِ predicates one shared D-H-M condition of two unstated referents.
baseline_models.mechanism: D-H-M places both referents at a chromatic threshold: literal dark blackness remains available, while the same branch explicitly includes watered greenness so intense that it tends toward black.

activation_trace.role: Dark blackness, including lush watered green that nears black, supplies the threshold-color mechanism for both referents.

changed_reading.before: Two simply dark or green entities.
changed_reading.after: Two entities whose color has intensified past ordinary green into near-black depth, without prematurely choosing blackness over hyper-greenness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual ending counts two wholes, while the D-H-M root can characterize what each whole contains or presents.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dense-multitude branch transfers darkness from a flat surface quality to internal compression: each of the two appears dark because many elements visually coalesce into a mass.

activation_trace.role: The dense-crowd image makes each dual referent an internally massed field rather than a uniform color patch.

changed_reading.before: The dual merely duplicates one color adjective.
changed_reading.after: The dual names two bounded wholes whose internal abundance resolves to the eye as dark density.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The single predicative form presents both referents as having entered or borne the same D-H-M state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The overwhelming-onset branch makes darkening eventive and pervasive: a condition has come over both referents and covered them, rather than merely assigning them a stable swatch.

activation_trace.role: The image of a sudden or pervasive coming-over supplies the directional motion by which darkness overtakes both referents.

changed_reading.before: Two objects possess a dark color.
changed_reading.after: A dark condition has spread over and saturated both objects; the word registers arrival and coverage as well as result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The D-H-M predicate itself can carry an affective branch before any contextual noun or valuation is supplied.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dark-calamity branch leaves a live ominous charge inside the bare dual darkness. It need not determine the referents, but it prevents the color from beginning as emotionally neutral.

activation_trace.role: The dark-affliction image contributes an ominous affective residue that later context may reverse without erasing.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is a neutral visual property.
changed_reading.after: The twofold darkness initially carries the pressure of something formidable or foreboding, pending contextual recoding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tree, bough, and garden branches convert chromatic intensity into canopy architecture: interlaced growth hides the interior and produces the near-black depth predicated by the focus.

activation_trace.role: Near-black color supplies the visible result whose material cause is reconstructed from the context.
Interlocking wood supplies a structural image for overlapping growth that blocks light.
Branching boughs extend the overlap into a layered canopy rather than an undifferentiated pigment.
A garden hidden by trees identifies the dual referents and makes concealment by vegetation the operative spatial mechanism.

structural_cues: 55:62 supplies the immediately preceding feminine-dual garden antecedent for the one-word dual predicate in 55:64.
The earlier pair at 55:48 is explicitly characterized by boughs, furnishing a canopy analogue without requiring both pairs to be identical.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interlocking wood, extending boughs, and a garden hidden by trees; I supply the arrow from canopy overlap to reduced light and near-black depth. Intrinsic plant color without shade causation remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Two gardens are intensely dark green.
changed_reading.after: Two gardens generate depth by their own interlaced canopy: their darkness is an effect of vegetal enclosure and hidden interior space.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context exposes two causal routes to the same dark endpoint: heat, charcoal, or smoke can blacken, while extreme greenness can also tend toward black. The local garden sequence selects the generative route but preserves the earlier destructive route as contrast.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch holds literal blackness and intensely watered green together at one visual endpoint.
Blackness associated with charcoal and smoke supplies the earlier punitive dark route used as a contrastive cause, not as the local gloss.
Green that blackens through sheer intensity directly confirms the garden unit's alternative route to darkness.

structural_cues: The hot-water circuit ends before the reward-garden sequence begins, while explicit greenness occurs later inside the same second-garden sequence as the focus.
The recurring refrain separates both dark regimes while also placing each under the same interrogative cadence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branch-backed heat-dark and hyper-green-dark routes; I infer that the local garden, water, and fruit sequence selects hyper-greenness while the earlier route remains an affective foil. The alternative is that no cross-scene chromatic contrast is intended.

changed_reading.before: The focus is simply a conventional word for deep green.
changed_reading.after: The focus occupies the shared endpoint of blackness and hyper-greenness, staging a reversal from destructive darkening to life-saturated darkening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flowing and gushing springs make darkness an ecological output of sustained irrigation. The retained-mark branch of N-D-KH sharpens this further: repeated water does not merely pass through but leaves a visible, enduring saturation in the vegetation.

activation_trace.role: Water-fed greenness nearing black supplies the focus-side result of the hydraulic mechanism.
Continuous running supplies the earlier pair's active-flow template rather than a static reservoir.
The flowing-water source locates the supply inside the same pair of gardens identified by the focus.
Abundant erupting water supplies the force and volume needed for saturation.
A coating whose trace remains turns repeated wetting into durable visible color.

structural_cues: After the refrain following 55:64, 55:66 immediately gives the same dual gardens two forceful springs.
The earlier garden pair also moves from boughs to running springs, making water-to-growth a repeated sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies watered near-black greenness, running springs, forceful abundance, and a retained trace; I infer irrigation as the cause of chromatic saturation. Dense shade or intrinsic coloration could produce the same appearance without this causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Dark green is a static ornamental color.
changed_reading.after: The near-black green is a visible water record: the gardens advertise a continuously supplied and retained surplus of irrigation.

context_deltas.mechanism: D-W-N keeps two relational geometries alive, proximity short of a farther limit and simple otherness. In either geometry, the focus color operates as the shared identity of a distinct second garden pair; it does not by itself prove inferior value.

activation_trace.role: The shared near-black condition gives the second dual pair a compact pair-level signature.
Proximity short of a farther endpoint supports a nearer-layer reading for the pair.
Simple otherness supports a noncomparative reading in which this is another pair rather than a lesser one.
The tree-hidden garden image supplies the noun resolved by the focus's feminine dual ending.

structural_cues: 55:46 introduces one dual garden pair and 55:62 introduces another; 55:64 agrees with the latter in feminine dual number.
No comparative adjective occurs in the focus itself, so relational rank must come from 55:62 rather than from darkness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two D-W-N relations and a second dual garden antecedent; I infer that the focus condition differentiates the pair as a unit. Evaluative lower rank remains a live third reading and cannot be settled by the focus root.

changed_reading.before: Two lower gardens are dark, with darkness treated as evidence of lesser rank.
changed_reading.after: A distinct second pair bears one dark-green identity; it may be nearer, other, or lower, and the focus does not collapse those relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal good, good action, and the garden antecedent reverse the calamity branch's valuation. Its darkness survives not as harm but as formidable beneficence: plenitude retains the pressure and scale of an overwhelming dark event.

activation_trace.role: The dark-affliction image contributes the ominous pressure that context must transform rather than silently discard.
Action met by its recompense supplies the local beneficent frame and reverses the dark branch's expected valence.
Good enacted as good fixes the reward frame in positive action rather than merely pleasant appearance.
The sheltered garden image gives the transformed darkness a paradisal material host.

structural_cues: The reciprocity statement at 55:60 leads through refrains at 55:61 and 55:63 into the focus.
The focus belongs to the reward inventory beginning at 55:62, not to the punitive circuit ending at 55:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal good, enacted good, and a garden; I infer that these reverse the dark-calamity branch from harmful event to awe-laden abundance while preserving its intensity. Plain positive color with no ominous residue remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The dark pair threatens gloom or calamity.
changed_reading.after: The pair's darkness is beneficence at formidable scale: the omen is reversed, but its felt weight becomes awe rather than disappearing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Kinds, paired classes, fruit, palms, and pomegranates populate the dense-multitude branch. Botanical plurality packed into each garden loses discrete edges at scale and presents as one dark mass.

activation_trace.role: The dense-multitude image converts many contents into the focus's unified dark appearance.
Multiplicity of kinds and forms supplies diversity within the garden class.
A color or class among kinds organizes abundance into paired varieties rather than random clutter.
Pleasant fruit supplies the generic productive layer of the mass.
Palm growth adds a named tall vegetal stratum to the compressed visual field.
Pomegranate adds a second named fruiting form, resisting a monoculture reading of the darkness.

structural_cues: The garden descriptions move from generic kinds and pairing to a compact list of differently structured plants and fruits.
The focus remains singular in lexical content but dual in agreement, allowing one mass-effect to summarize heterogeneous contents in each garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinds, paired classes, and named produce; I transfer the D-H-M crowd image from people to vegetation and infer that compressed biodiversity causes visual darkness. The branch may instead be a remote human-crowd association with no botanical force.

changed_reading.before: Each garden is a uniform dark-green surface.
changed_reading.after: Each garden is a biodiverse multitude whose many layers visually collapse into a single dark-green mass.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intertwining vegetation, erupting water, and spreading quivering green give directional force to the focus's overwhelming-onset branch. The gardens become an environment that closes and advances around the perceiver, not a distant tableau.

activation_trace.role: The pervasive onset image supplies the focus-side motion of a dark condition coming over its field.
Intertwining and thrusting vegetation gives the surrounding growth an active vector.
Abundant water bursting out adds outward pressure and continual movement.
Spreading, trembling greenery extends the motion to the garden's visible surfaces.

structural_cues: The compressed one-word focus opens afterward into springs, fruit, inhabitants, tents, and green furnishings, creating an expansion from predicate to enveloping scene.
Dual agreement makes the same oncoming condition operate across both gardens at once.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intertwining growth, erupting water, and spreading movement; I infer convergence around an implied perceiver and read D-H-M as immersive onset. The live alternative is that these are independent static amenities and the focus only names their color.

changed_reading.before: The viewer looks at two dark-green gardens from outside.
changed_reading.after: The paired gardens come over the viewer as an advancing field of shade, water, and moving green; darkness becomes immersion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remaining, continuous provision, and stable growing good revise eventive darkening into a renewed steady state. The garden can continually arrive as an experience while its ecological saturation persists rather than peaking once.

activation_trace.role: The overwhelming-onset image supplies an eventive reading that the temporal context transforms into recurrent arrival.
Enduring remainder supplies the broad persistence pole against which the garden state is read.
Continuing provision converts water movement into renewable maintenance rather than one-time flow.
Stable, growing good closes the sequence with increase that remains in place.

structural_cues: The surah's perish-and-remain contrast at 55:26-27 precedes both garden inventories, and 55:78 closes the whole sequence with enduring increase.
The garden water is grammatically ongoing in 55:50 and forcefully abundant in 55:66.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistence, ongoing provision, and stable increase; I infer that these temporal cues govern the maintenance of the focus color and turn a single onset into renewal. Because the cues are distributed across the surah, a purely local momentary state remains plausible.

changed_reading.before: Both gardens have just darkened at a peak moment.
changed_reading.after: Their dark saturation is a self-renewing steady state: continually supplied, continually arriving to perception, and not exhausted by one event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's specialized confinement and site applications through nearby shelter vocabulary rather than through its dominant color branch. It remains anchored in D-H-M B005 and in branch-backed garden, confinement, and tent images; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy for retained shade and moisture, never as a lexical gloss or a claim that the gardens imprison anyone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: D-H-M B005 includes confined, fettered, and site-bound applications, while the feminine dual still fixes the analogy to the two focus referents.

activation_trace.role: Specialized dark labels involving confinement, fettering, plants, and sites supply the focus-side enclosure analogy.
Covering and concealment turn enclosure into a property of the garden environment.
Restriction to a bounded thing supplies containment rather than mere smallness.
Tent and abiding supply a sheltered habitat image capable of holding a distinct microclimate.

changed_reading.before: The gardens' darkness is only exposed surface color.
changed_reading.after: Their darkness can be carried as the signature of an enclosed microclimate that holds shade and moisture within bounded vegetal shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because gaze-restraint language elsewhere in the garden sequence is transferred to landscape perception. It remains valid as a perceptual model through the focus's dark-black branch and branch-backed twilight, gaze-turning, and eye-contrast images; downstream prose should mark it as an analogy about how depth is seen, not claim that the gaze constructions grammatically modify the gardens.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The near-black D-H-M condition can describe not only what the dual referents look like but the point at which their interiors cease to be visually penetrable.

activation_trace.role: Dark blackness supplies the loss of visible interior detail at the focus itself.
Twilight and mixed darkness supply a threshold condition in which sight becomes limited.
Turning the gaze back supplies the perceptual arrest produced by excessive depth.
Strong eye contrast sharpens darkness as a boundary generated in vision rather than merely a pigment on objects.

changed_reading.before: Two objects display a very dark green color.
changed_reading.after: Two fields of growth become limits of seeing: their saturated depth arrests and turns the gaze because the interior no longer resolves.

strongest_changes: The later KH-D-R branch makes the black-green threshold explicit, while the earlier H-M-M branch preserves a destructive dark route as contrast.
J-N-N, F-N-N, and SH-J-R turn color into a canopy-and-concealment mechanism.
J-R-Y, AY-N, and N-D-KH turn the near-black green into a durable record of abundant irrigation.
J-Z-Y and H-S-N reverse the calamity branch's valence without deleting its formidable affective pressure.
D-W-N leaves nearer, other, and lower relations coexisting; the focus color identifies the second pair but does not decide its rank.
summary.what_was_special: A one-word dual focus sustained unusually different mechanisms at once: chromatic threshold, canopy shade, hydraulic saturation, compressed biodiversity, immersive onset, and renewed persistence. Context did more than identify two gardens; it repeatedly changed what their darkness does.
remaining_uncertainties: The multitude and overwhelming-onset branches may be active cross-domain resonances rather than components of the local lexical sense.
D-W-N does not settle whether the second pair is nearer, simply other, or lower in rank.
The contrast between punitive heat-darkness and life-saturated darkness may be a reader-supplied compositional relation rather than an intended chromatic pairing.
The enclosure and gaze-limit outliers are structurally anchored but remain analogical and should not be promoted to unqualified glosses.
